hypothesis: A small set of causal and independently motivated trend, market, participation, expansion, and structure axes can remove false ETH 15m V16 launches without destroying the strategy's large-winner right tail.
single_selected_variable: one gate id from the twelve fixed candidate gates
audit_data: committed V16 2025-through-February-2026 ledger; already seen and diagnostic only
audit_opening_rule: No audit ledger may be loaded unless exactly one development gate passes all registered opening conditions and the selection receipt is committed.
multiplicity: A 50,000-resample max-statistic outcome permutation covers all twelve fixed masks; the selected arm must pass the familywise p gate.
right_tail_rule: A gate must retain at least 45% of the baseline top-decile positive PnL and at least 85% of baseline P95 net return in development.
causality_test: Mutating every ETH and BTC raw row at or after 2024-07-01 must not change any feature attached to signals before that boundary.
